newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-GRASSI ON THE WAY BACK AFTER INFECTION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GRASSI ON THE WAY BACK AFTER INFECTION.

text.p: Monaco's Swiss international Marco Grassi, out of action since the start of the season with a lingering foot infection, has resumed training and will make his comeback in the coming weeks.
"My virus problems to the arch of the foot are solved at last," said the 28-year-old striker, who transferred from Rennes at the start ot the season.

Grassi, a key member of the Swiss national team, is one of Monaco's numerous absentees this season. French international Eric di Meco and Belgian playmaker Enzo Scifo have also been nursing lingering injuries in recent weeks.
